title: Live stream text stops short when the model pauses
observed: internal/tui/bridge.go handleStreamEvent sent MsgStreamText at most once per 50ms and dropped deltas inside the window with no trailing send, so when a stream paused (a slow model between bursts, a held faux turn) the live region showed only the text up to the last unthrottled delta until the next delta or the message end.
expected: Everything that has arrived is on screen within one throttle window, even when no further delta comes.
evidence: TestBridge_StreamText_TrailingFlush fails without the trailing flush: armed 0 flushes, only 'The limi' sent.
